key_insight: QuantumChain combines hybrid quantum-classical federated learning with encryption and blockchain to improve fraud detection privacy, auditability, and class-imbalance performance.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets real-world financial networks by enabling secure multi-client training without centralizing sensitive transaction data.
method: Local hybrid quantum-classical neural networks with a variational quantum circuit between classical layers
Encrypted federated aggregation using homomorphic encryption, threshold secret sharing, and QKD-based key exchange
Permissioned blockchain for auditable aggregation and reputation-weighted trust among clients
evidence_signal: On financial transaction data, the HQNN matched classical accuracy while improving fraud-class recall to 94.6% vs 93.2%, and federated accuracy rose from 97.7% to 98.8% over five rounds with 10 heterogeneous clients.
watch_item: The added cryptographic, blockchain, and quantum-simulation layers may increase implementation complexity and communication overhead in practical deployments.
paper_title: QuantumChain: Blockchain-Backed Quantum Federated Learning for Financial Fraud Detection
